source.title: Squat - exercise demonstration video.webm
source.author: FitnessScape
source.whole_action_inspection: OBSERVED: the complete 7.100 s source was decoded in order on primary-phone and inspected as 28 ordered 4 fps grayscale ASCII representations before keys were chosen. The coherent second squat repetition 4.000–6.750 s was then inspected as a tighter ordered 2 fps crop, with 30 fps frame-difference measurements used only to locate change windows. Source pixels remained analysis-only and are absent from all outputs.

builder.input: motion.json only; source video is never required for output rendering

iterations.inspect: Rendered decisive-key montage from MP4. Ground/bar constraints read, compression arc read, but RESTACK and SETTLE_READY were visually identical.
iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: RECOVERY/COST NOT VISIBLE: the load cost disappeared at top because K5 duplicated K6.
iterations.correction: Changed K5 to RESTACK_WITH_RESIDUAL_FLEX: torso/bar remain one row low and knees remain visibly flexed; removed bottom hold-snap so authored K3→K4 drive connects without teleport.

iterations.inspect: Re-rendered MP4 inspected as ordered output frames including K0,K1,K2,K3, K3→K4 connective frame, K4,K5,K6 and terminal hold.
iterations.visible_result: PASS: silhouette compresses and re-extends; bar/hands remain constrained; L/R ground supports stay fixed; bottom reversal is authored; ascent continues visibly; K5 carries residual flex before K6 readiness. No transition invents support/contact release or root teleport.

noodle_queen.inspect: Final post-Tango rendered sequence inspected at decisive and connective frames.

consider.taste: Specific loaded-squat silhouette, not a generic bob: the long bar, fixed bilateral feet, progressively widening/deepening knee geometry, and residual-flex restack all participate in one readable action.
consider.function: The animation teaches one useful causal distinction: bottom reversal changes force direction while contact/support remain continuous. Root/load travel, recovery and cost are legible without source pixels.
consider.contempt: Rejects the cheap version where the rig merely squashes and springs back. The residual-flex K5 and explicit bottom key prevent consequence-free tween sludge.

reasons: Support and carried-load contact remain readable through the reversal.
Recovery visibly pays residual flex before readiness.
The specimen is compact and worth attention because it isolates a non-contact causal event: force-direction reversal under unchanged support.
